source.attribution: NeqSim master, SystemPrEos with the matching AttractiveTerm* - the upstream this library is a port of, run from validation/neqsim/FlashTp.java
source.notes: Schwartzentruber's correlation, three fitted parameters from the `schwartzentruber1..3` columns. azoth's `psi_t` follows the true second derivative; NeqSim's `diffdiffalphaT` is the same form, so the departure functions agree. NeqSim's `Tr > 100` high-temperature extrapolation is not ported - no ordinary state reaches it.

derivation:
The driver was run for methane 0.6 / n-butane 0.4 at 330 K and 25 bar on SystemPrEos with `setAttractiveTerm(2)`. NeqSim printed:

  beta 0.801215312486502
  k    [8.531955901511383, 0.29768899599101184]
  x    [0.08529126054174284, 0.9147087394582571]
  y    [0.7277012737264675, 0.2722987262735325]
  Zl   0.09169667326343119
  Zv   0.886558418261009

azoth reproduces all six to the same residue the other cubic cases show.
